questions_and_answers.question_text: Write the Chinese for "This medicine is very effective."
Write the Chinese for "Is this ticket still valid?"
In which two senses can yǒu xiào be used?
Which word is used for a medicine that works?

answers.answer_text: Yǒu xiào — Zhèige yào hěn yǒu xiào.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Which word is used for a ticket that is still good?

answers.answer_text: Yǒu xiào — Zhèizhāng piào hái yǒu xiào ma?

questions_and_answers.question_text: What is the opposite sense of yǒu xiào?
Is luàn used as an adjectival verb or an adverb?

answers.answer_text: Both — as an adjectival verb ("to be chaotic") and as an adverb ("any old way").

questions_and_answers.question_text: What does xiào mean in yǒu xiào?

articles.text:
Notes on Additional Required Vocabulary

10. luàn        to be confused, to be chaotic
11. yǒu xiào    to be effective; to be valid

yǒu xiào: "to be effective; to be valid"

Zhèige yào hěn yǒu xiào.         This medicine is very effective.
Zhèizhāng piào hái yǒu xiào ma?  Is this ticket still valid?
